'''Jax Pavan''' was a common [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] name. Circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] it was the name of 582,797,754 [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|males]] and an unknown number of females on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Yaam Sector]] alone was home to 8,673 men who shared this name. This large number vexed [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], when he was given the task of hunting down a surviving [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] named Jax Pavan.

This [[Jax Pavan|particular Jax Pavan]] was the son of [[Lorn Pavan]]. He worked as a [[Private investigator/Legends|private investigator]], initially operating out of [[Yaam Sector|Yamm Sector's]] lower regions, also known as the Blackpit Slums, however he and his team were forced to relocate more than once due to the efforts of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]]. The common nature of the name led the Jedi to not bother adopting an alias, despite the risk of making it marginally easier to track him down. He regarded this as a small act of defiance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which had taken everything else from him during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].
